name: Hindi flood rescue near Chalakudy temple
transcript: नमस्ते, हम वार्ड 7 में चालाकुडी महादेव मंदिर के पास फंसे हैं। पानी कमर तक आ गया है, घर में 4 लोग हैं, एक छोटा बच्चा और बुजुर्ग दादी हैं। कृपया जल्दी नाव भेजिए।

name: English medical urgency at Aluva Bus Stand
transcript: Hello relief desk, behind Aluva Bus Stand the water is rising fast. Five people are in the house. Grandmother has asthma and needs an oxygen cylinder urgently.

name: English stranded terrace at Nedumudi Boat Jetty
transcript: Emergency report from Nedumudi Boat Jetty, 6 people stranded on the terrace. Water level rising fast, we need a rescue boat immediately.

name: English ration shortage at Champakulam School
transcript: Drinking water and dry rations have run out for 20 families at the Champakulam School relief camp in ward 2. Please send supplies.

name: English dog bite in Anthikad
transcript: In Anthikad, ward 9, lane 4, a stray dog bit a child. The wound is bleeding. Please send an ambulance and a rabies injection.

name: English riverfront rescue in ward 7
transcript: Three people are stranded on the riverfront in ward 7. Please send a boat immediately. This is a synthetic report.

name: English noisy report at Nedumudi
transcript: Two people are stranded near Nedumudi in ward 3. The water is very high and they need a boat.

name: English update for ward 7
transcript: Update: we said 3 people earlier. There are 5 people now and the water has reached the first floor. Please come quickly.
